name: gitlab_list_projects
description: List all accessible GitLab projects. Returns project ID, name, path, description, star count, and URL. Use gitlab_get_project to fetch detailed info.

owned.description: If true, only return projects owned by the user (default: false)

per_page.description: Number of projects to return (default 20, max 100)

name: gitlab_get_project
description: Get details for a specific GitLab project (e.g., project ID "123" or path "group/project"). Returns name, description, visibility, stars, forks, and default branch.

id.description: Project ID (numeric, e.g. "278964") or full path "namespace/project" (e.g. "gitlab-org/gitlab"). Pass the plain path — do NOT URL-encode it; the pack encodes it.

name: gitlab_list_issues
description: Search issues in a GitLab project by project ID. Returns issue ID, title, state (open/closed), labels, assignee, and URL. Filter by status and labels.

project_id.description: Project ID (numeric) or full path "namespace/project" (e.g. "gitlab-org/gitlab") — pass the plain path, do not URL-encode it.

search.description: Search issues by title or description

per_page.description: Number of issues to return (default 20, max 100)

name: gitlab_list_mrs
description: List merge requests in a GitLab project by project ID. Returns MR ID, title, state, author, source/target branches, and URL. Filter by state and author.

project_id.description: Project ID (numeric) or full path "namespace/project" (e.g. "gitlab-org/gitlab") — pass the plain path, do not URL-encode it.

per_page.description: Number of merge requests to return (default 20, max 100)

name: gitlab_get_file
description: Fetch file content from a GitLab repository by project ID and file path (e.g., "src/main.py"). Returns decoded content, file size, name, and encoding.

project_id.description: Project ID (numeric) or full path "namespace/project" (e.g. "gitlab-org/gitlab") — pass the plain path, do not URL-encode it.

file_path.description: Path to the file within the repository

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA (default: default branch)
